title: plur1bus.plugin-feed/1
description: Signed PLUR1BUS plugin feed, published at https://updates.plur1bus.app/plugin/{channel}.json with a minisign signature at {channel}.json.minisig (HM1-R2, HM1-R4). Consumers verify the signature before trusting any URL or hash in it. Every object is closed except `notes`. build-plugin-feed.mjs enforces this schema with a hand-written validator of the same subset (type, const, enum, pattern, required, properties, additionalProperties, items, minItems, $ref) plus the semantic rules named in the descriptions. URLs may be file:// only for test feeds; the bootstraps and the installer refuse file:// outside PLUR1BUS_PLUGIN_INSTALLER_TEST=1.

installer.description: The bundled Node installer (plur1bus-plugin-installer.mjs) the bootstraps download and hand over to.

openclaw.description: Semantic rules: `latest` equals releases[0].version; releases are sorted newest first by semver and versions are unique.

windowsNativeBeta.description: While true the installer prints that Windows native support is in beta (HM1-R18).

release.description: Semantic rules: clawhub equals clawhub:@cyb3rb1ade/plur1bus-memory@<version>; npm, when present, equals npm:@cyb3rb1ade/plur1bus-memory@<version>.

tarball.description: The npm-pack tarball on the GitHub Release; integrity is npm's (sha512-<base64>) and must equal `npm pack --json` for the same bytes.

clawpackDigest.description: ClawHub's ClawPack digest, added after the manual ClawHub publish when it differs from the npm integrity (HM1-R15).

compat.description: package.json openclaw.compat of the released tarball.

node.description: package.json engines.node of the released tarball.

security.description: True when the release fixes a security issue.

notes.description: Release notes (Markdown). German and English are required (D78); other languages may be added.
